buffer_size_kb.description: Size of the pointer-chasing buffer in KB

iterations.description: Number of pointer-chase iterations per measurement

seed.description: The seed used for the generation of input data

validation_path.description: if the validation is file based, the path where the comparison files is located

validation_type.description: How the workload should be validated

device.description: The device number to run on

lock_clock.description: If the clocks should be locked

min_clock_value.description: -1 means locking to the base clock, else is locking to a specific frequency

max_clock_value.description: -1 means locking to the base clock, else is locking to a specific frequency

block_duration.description: Duration of the blocking kernel (in ms)

warm_cool.description: Does the Benchmark actively warm or cool the GPU

dynamic_batch.description: If the batch size is dynamic

block_queue_size.description: The max size of the blocking queue

flush.description: Enables the flushing of the L2 cache

min_gpu_temp.description: If warm_cool, the minimum accepted temperature before warming up the GPU

minimal_batch_duration.description: If dynamic batch size is set tu true, how long a batch should minimaly be

warm_cool_timeout.description: How long the benchmark warms or cool before throwing

max_gpu_temp.description: If warm_cool, the minimum accepted temperature before cooling down the GPU

validate_workload.description: If you want the workload results to be validated
